hub.name: SEO services
hub.line: Fixes made in the code. No ranking promises.

hero.joke: Nobody can promise you first place on Google. Anyone who does is selling something else.
hero.intro: SEO services in Dubai from a studio that builds websites. Technical SEO, on-page work, site speed and structured data, fixed directly in the code. You get changes made, not a PDF of suggestions.

items.p: Crawling, indexing, broken links, duplicate pages, redirects. Everything that stops a search engine reading your site.
Titles, descriptions, headings and internal links, rewritten around the words your customers type.
Slow pages fixed at the source: images, scripts, fonts, things that jump about. Our [Core Web Vitals guide](/blog/core-web-vitals-guide/) explains the measures.
Markup that tells search engines what a page is: a business, a product, an article, a list of questions.
Which pages should exist, which should merge, and which are quietly competing with each other.
Google Search Console connected and explained, so you can watch the numbers without us.

fit.p: Sometimes it isn't. Sometimes the site ranks fine and the page people land on is what's wrong. We check which problem you have before selling you the cure.
yes: Live for months with almost no search traffic
Ranking for your own name and little else
Told you need SEO, but never told what's wrong
Planning a redesign and worried about losing rankings
fit.no: you want leads by next week. SEO is slow. Ads are quick and cost money every day, and that's [digital marketing](/services/digital-marketing/). Most businesses end up needing a bit of both.

items.p: We crawl the site, read Search Console and list what's wrong, in order of how much it matters.
A short plan with realistic targets and a fixed quote. We say which goals take weeks and which take months.
We make the changes ourselves, in the code and the CMS. Then we check they worked.
What changed and what moved, in plain words. If you'd like ongoing work, it becomes a monthly plan.

price.p: An audit shows how much is wrong, and that decides the price. One-off fixes get a fixed quote. Ongoing work is a fixed monthly fee. Every site we build already ships with the SEO basics, at no extra charge.

tools.note: Written as words on purpose. Google is particular about its logos, and we're not its partner.

faq.q: Can you guarantee first place on Google?
faq.a: No, and nobody honest can. We fix what's measurably wrong, aim at realistic terms and report what changes. That's the part that adds up over time.
Technical fixes can show within weeks, once pages are crawled again. Competitive terms take months. We tell you which kind your goals are before you pay for anything.
We don't buy links or mass-produce them. That breaks Google's rules and can get a site penalised. We focus on listings you own, real reviews and pages worth linking to.

faq.q: Do I need SEO if you built my site?
faq.a: The basics are already in. A separate SEO project goes further: content, structure and keeping up with competitors. Redesigning an older site? Read [how to redesign a website without losing SEO](/blog/website-redesign-without-losing-seo/) first.

cta.p: Send us your site and the search terms you wish you owned. We'll tell you what's in the way.
